name: Kusumi Ai
source:
Born on May 27, 1989. Gemini. Blood type is O. Member of the Softball club. Her hobby is karaoke.
She has straight hair that drops onto her shoulders. She has a frugal personality and is able to clearly express her opinion to anyone, and although she's often alone and disengages from group activities, she also has a caring side to her classmates. She likes cats.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/3年B組金八先生_伝説の教壇に立て!]Wikipedia[/url]]
